svg.title: Figure 05 · European call sensitivities across maturities
svg.desc: K = 100, r = 5%, q = 0, σ = 20%. Gamma concentrates near the strike as expiry approaches; vega tends to zero. Theta uses calendar time, ∂V/∂t, and is shown per year.
